{{samename|Ampharos known as [[Sparkle]] in the English dub of {{aniseries|GS}}|Amphy}} {{Japanese name}} {{PrevNext |prev=Let me battle |next=Ready Go |list=Japanese ending themes |colorscheme=Paldea}} {{Song |type=HZ ED 03 |language=ja |title=ピッカーン！ |transliterated=Pikkaan! |translated=Sparkle! |screen=hd |screenshot=HZ ED 03.png |artistname=松田里奈＆森田ひかる（櫻坂46） |artistname_ro=Rina Matsuda & Hikaru Morita ({{wp|Sakurazaka46}}) |lyricist=en |lyricistname={{wp|DECO*27}} (OTOIRO) |composer=en |composername=Giga & TeddyLoid |arranger=en |arrangername=Giga & TeddyLoid |albumtype=album |albumtitle=ピッカーン！ |albumtitle_ro={{CD|Sparkle!}} |catalognumber=SRCL-13150～13152, SRCL-13153～13155 |recordcompany=Sony Music Labels |colorscheme=Paldea}} '''Sparkle!''' (Japanese: '''ピッカーン！''' ''Pikkaan!'') is the Japanese ending theme for the ''[[Rayquaza Rising]]'' arc and the third of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]''. It debuted as an ending song in [[HZ068]], replacing [[Let me battle]]. It aired until [[HZ088]], when it was replaced by [[Ready Go]]. The full version of the song was first released as a [[List of Pokémon digital singles#Sparkle!|digital single]] on October 18, 2024.[https://sakurazaka46.com/s/s46/news/detail/R00390 テレビアニメ「ポケットモンスター」エンディングテーマ『ピッカーン！』に松田里奈と森田ひかるが歌唱参加決定！ | ニュース | 櫻坂46公式サイト] ==Ending animation== ===Synopsis=== Six silhouettes stand in front of a brick wall, adorned with neon signs of the {{t|Fire}}, {{t|Grass}}, {{t|Water}}, and {{t|Electric}} types, as well as the symbol of the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]]. As the camera zooms in, the six silhouettes raise their hands before jumping on the beat as the spotlight comes on, revealing to be [[Liko]], [[Roy]], [[Dot]], and their respective partner Pokémon. Under a green lighting, Liko and {{TP|Liko|Floragato}} dance to the music before Dot and {{TP|Dot|Quaxwell}} transition across the screen to change the focus to Roy and {{TP|Roy|Crocalor}} dancing under a red lighting on the opposite side of the screen. The focus returns to the six of them as they dance together, with the outstretched hands of the {{pkmn|Trainer}}s creating a light that makes a white screen. On a green screen, Liko and {{p|Sprigatito}} are above [[Indigo Academy]]. A red screen comes up next, with Roy and {{p|Fuecoco}} being above the [[Roy's hometown|former's island]]. Finally, a blue screen appears with Dot and {{p|Quaxly}} hovering above [[Levincia]]. Liko, with her eyes closed, circles around the screen and fills it with pink mist. {{an|Terapagos}} swims around before the camera focuses on Liko, who opens her eyes. Liko runs alone on a pink background, later being joined by Sprigatito and {{p|Hatenna}}, who then change into Floragato and {{TP|Liko|Hattrem}}. The camera zooms out, revealing the trio running to be a disc on a player that is surrounded by various items such as a [[Rotom Phone]] and [[Captain Pikachu]]'s hat. A figure of Terapagos in its {{form|Terapagos|Terastal Form}} appears in the middle of the screen, with figures of the [[first partner Pokémon]] sprouting from it. The scene changes to the younger members of the Rising Volt Tacklers and their Pokémon. The camera pans over them before switching to the rear view of them jumping (except for {{TP|Roy|Kilowattrel}}, who is flying instead) towards the sky. As the camera rises up, the [[Brave Olivine]] is facing the same direction while the [[Black Rayquaza]] is ahead of everyone else before breaking into a film-like montage. Floragato turns to face the camera behind her, and the scene repeats with a grid of nine rectangles, with Liko and Hattrem doing the same in pink rectangles and Terapagos smiling in front of Floragato in another rectangle. Crocalor, Roy, and Kilowattrel line up wearing shades as they spread out horizontally. Nidothing, Quaxwell, and {{TP|Dot|Tinkatink}} leap to the left of the screen as a shadow of Dot is shown behind Nidothing's suit. Five shadows appear on the screen before they quickly go up, revealing to belong to the older members of the Rising Volt Tacklers as they dance surrounded by their own partner Pokémon and the [[wild Pokémon]] living aboard the Brave Olivine. Liko and Floragato dance in front of a brick wall under a green lighting before switching to Roy and Crocalor under a red one. Floragato, Crocalor, and Quaxwell bounce around on an equalizer in front of an image of Captain Pikachu before leaping out of the screen. ===Characters=== ====Humans==== *[[Liko]] *[[Roy]] *[[Friede]] *[[Orla]] *[[Ludlow]] *[[Murdock]] *[[Mollie]] *[[Dot]] ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Sprigatito}} ({{OP|Liko|Sprigatito}}) * {{p|Floragato}} ({{OP|Liko|Floragato}}) * {{p|Hattrem}} ({{OP|Liko|Hattrem}}) * {{p|Hatenna}} ({{OP|Liko|Hatenna}}) * {{p|Terapagos}} ({{OP|Liko|Terapagos}}; {{form|Terapagos|Normal Form}}) * {{p|Fuecoco}} ({{OP|Roy|Fuecoco}}) * {{p|Crocalor}} ({{OP|Roy|Crocalor}}) * {{p|Kilowattrel}} ({{OP|Roy|Kilowattrel}}) * {{p|Rayquaza}} ([[Lucius]]'s; [[Black Rayquaza]]) * {{p|Charizard}} ({{OP|Friede|Charizard}}) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Friede]]'s; [[Captain Pikachu]]) * {{p|Metagross}} ([[Orla]]'s) * {{p|Elekid}} ([[Orla]]'s) * {{p|Quagsire}} ([[Ludlow]]'s) * {{p|Sharpedo}} ([[Ludlow]]'s) * {{p|Rockruff}} ({{OP|Murdock|Rockruff}}) * {{p|Alcremie}} ({{OP|Murdock|Alcremie}}; {{form|Alcremie|Strawberry Ruby Swirl}}) * {{p|Chansey}} ({{OP|Mollie|Chansey}}) * {{p|Quaxly}} ({{OP|Dot|Quaxly}}) * {{p|Quaxwell}} ({{OP|Dot|Quaxwell}}) * {{p|Tinkatink}} ({{OP|Dot|Tinkatink}}; [[HZ068]]-[[HZ069]]) * {{p|Tinkatuff}} ({{OP|Dot|Tinkatuff}}; [[HZ070]]-[[HZ088]]) * {{p|Pawmi}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Shuckle}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Snorunt}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Noctowl}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Carkol}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Slugma}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Muk}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]'; [[Alolan form]]) * {{p|Nosepass}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Polteageist}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Sinistea}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Maushold}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]'; {{form|Maushold|Family of Four}}) * {{p|Tatsugiri}} (×3; [[Rising Volt Tacklers]]'; {{form|Tatsugiri|Curly, Droopy, and Stretchy forms}}) ==Lyrics== ====TV size==== {{Schemetable|Paldea}} !
